player_note: The post (7 June 2000) says: "4-0 at the regional beating both Michael Riboulet and Gary Carman." The description calls it "The deck I used at the Naboo regional" and the post is signed "Michael Kessling / Naboo regional runner-up." The regional was played on 4 June 2000 at Hatfield, Hertfordshire; Michael Riboulet won it.
